notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 attribute scope advisory surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies switch enable/disable behavior, regional source reassociation, regional subscription removal and restoration, grouped attributesInScope and attributesOutOfScope callbacks, stale evoked-callback suppression after a committed region change, and independent region and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attribute-scope advisory switches, regional object registration and association, regional subscription and unsubscription, region modification, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador scope callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador attribute scope advisory declarations
